About

Why this exists

This is a small corner of the internet for honest thoughts, experiences, memories and feelings shared anonymously.

People can send their stories privately through Instagram. The website owner personally reads the submissions and selects stories to feature here.

Not every story will necessarily be published. The goal is to keep this space thoughtful, respectful and human.

Have a story of your own?

Send your story privately through Instagram. If we feel your story belongs here, we may feature it anonymously.
